$comment: P15.12 EAS Update channels: JS-only fixes ship over the air with a staged rollout and instant rollback. Neither patient-app/eas.json nor provider-app/eas.json declares an updates channel today (verified: no 'updates' key) — adding the channel there is an app-source change owned by the app agents. This file is the gate-side contract those edits must satisfy, and the rollout/rollback scripts beside it consume it.
procedure: publish the fix to branch staging, verify on internal devices
publish the same update group to production-5pct and monitor crash-free users + error budget for 24h
promote the identical group to production-full (no rebuild: same update id)
on any regression: rollback.sh (republish last-good group), then fix forward on staging
